name: cypherpoet-obsidian-plugin-kit
description: Comprehensive Obsidian plugin development: scaffolding from the official sample-plugin template, the vault/editor/workspace APIs, lifecycle and memory safety, settings tabs (classic and the 1.13 declarative API), mobile and pop-out support, eslint-plugin-obsidianmd review, and community-directory submission — grounded in the official Obsidian developer docs, with a dependency-free manifest/release preflight validator.
